method: Read final rendered body and inspect screenshots. Guides must answer the task, provide an executable method and a specific sourced constraint. Comparisons either meet the verified contract or explicitly remain unavailable. HTML contract checks cover both languages.

samples.purpose: 用真实稿件检查起草、事实与交付格式
samples.executableMethodOrBoundary: 同一简报，逐项核查数字与引用，分别记录起草和编辑时间
samples.specificLimitation: Google 对生成内容的准确性、质量和相关性要求

samples.purpose: 判断生成或剪辑输出能否进入最终成片
samples.executableMethodOrBoundary: 相同分镜，检查连续性、剪辑接入和交付分辨率
samples.specificLimitation: Runway 的 4K 编辑器导出不会把非 4K 素材放大

samples.purpose: 用可复现缺陷评估编码助手的修改与审查成本

samples.purpose: 区分资料发现、文献理解和可追溯引用

samples.purpose: 验证流程失败后能否恢复并避免重复写入
